expected_findings.description: The person_metadata scenario expects the flag to evaluate to true from a same-named caller property, but the new requirement makes any type outside person, group, cohort, and flag inconclusive and forbids matching it against a caller-supplied property with the same key

Flags with unknown filter types stay unresolved and never request /flags even when local-only mode is off, which contradicts flags-fallback/spec.md: an inconclusive result for any cause MUST fall back to the remote endpoint unless local-only mode is on
The warning requirement uses a lowercase 'should' and the condition 'when it makes sense', so an SDK cannot be tested against it
The scenario calls the flag 'undetermined' while every requirement calls the same state 'inconclusive'

false_positive_traps.description: The logging SHOULD states its rationale (one log line per request otherwise) and a scenario with a countable result, so it is testable and correctly not a MUST
